body:
Pass 26. Correcting myself, and flagging an acceptance gap before Epic 7 closes.

My pass-19 "no detectable leakage" was based on the NULL only. Under SIGNAL the policies differ materially: paired diff -0.002028, MCse 0.000207, z = -9.81. train-only is biased +0.0011 high vs the population target, all-runs -0.0009 low; all-runs also has lower variance and RMSE.

The mechanism is learner quality, not leakage - with R=4, excluding both evaluated runs leaves training-only with 2 runs of residuals vs 4 for all-runs, and a noisier Sigma_hat inverts to a larger K. That is exactly the evaluator-correctness vs learner-quality distinction your criterion 5 asks for. To isolate provenance, match the arms on NUMBER of training runs (e.g. R=6, 4 training runs both arms).

Acceptance gap: your 5 test blocks / 34 expectations are all structural. Three criteria met, one partial, three not met - the paired-simulation reporting, the evaluator-vs-learner distinction, and the durable evidence report. grep for replicate/margin/colMeans/seed finds nothing. The last one is live now, since there IS a material difference to report.

Full numbers are in the decision note on the bead, ready to lift.
